question: Who may claim a paid workbook into an organization, may any member of that organization (whatever their role) read, change and delete its memory holders and export it, and what authority does a person who holds only the workbook identifier keep over an unclaimed workbook?
decision: Only a verified organization officer/admin may claim a paid workbook using a single-use expiry-bound claim capability. Before claim, the workbook ID alone grants no access; use a separate high-entropy expiring capability token and access logging. After claim, only named authorized participants read sensitive memory-holder records; officers/admins with designated mandate may edit, delete or export. Do not expose named people and free-text to every member.
originalProposedDecision: Only an admin or officer may claim. After claim, members read; officers and above write, delete and export. Before claim, the identifier gives read and write for 30 days only.
